text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. For example, instead of saying "improve the website," a SMART goal would be "redesign the homepage by June 30th to increase visitor engagement by 20%." It is also important to define milestones, which are key checkpoints along the way, and deliverables, the final products you must complete. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on these goals from the start. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
